title: Just Juice Mint Range Red Mint Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Red Mint Saltfill combines juicy Cherry with a subtle streak of cool Mint. Sweet fruitiness meets a refreshing edge, creating a balanced blend that’s smooth, bright, and ideal for all-day vaping. Each Saltfill bottle contains 40ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml format, leaving space for up to two nic shots. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, this e-liquid is best suited for pod kits and MTL devices, producing a well-defined flavour with a tactile throat hit. Double-concentrated flavouring ensures Red Mint remains vibrant and consistent throughout the day. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
